nora_cust: Hey @jordan_support we're seeing a bunch of "Invalid JSON" errors when using json_mode=structured on /v1/generate in prod. Happens intermittently (~2% of requests). Error shows "parse_error: unexpected token at position 342". Started after the 03/05 rollout.

jordan_support: Hi Nora — thanks for the report. Can you paste a redacted request_id and whether you're using streaming=true? Also a short sample of the model response (the raw response body) would help.

nora_cust: request_id: req_20260305_9f3a. We use streaming=true with chunking=on. Attached a trimmed response we captured (redacted):
```
[
  {"id":"item_1","attributes":{"name":"alice","tags":["x"]}},
  {"id":"item_2","attributes":null, "metadata":{"source":"ingest"}, "extra_field":"meta"},
  {"id":"item_3","attributes":{"name":"carol"}}
]
```
When the client tries to parse that stream it throws parse_error because the second item sometimes arrives split like `...\"attributes\":null,` then the next chunk starts `\" \"metadata\":...` (note the extra space) and our NDJSON combiner fails.

jordan_support: Thanks — that snippet is super helpful. Reproducing locally now. Does the app log show any truncation or socket resets around req_20260305_9f3a?

nora_cust: No socket resets, just the parse exception and a retry from our side. We also saw a spike in tokens billed for those requests because our retry loop triggers another full request.

jordan_support: Understood. Escalating to eng-ml to check streaming recombination and whether extra fields are being injected. cc @maya_ml @oncall_bob.

maya_ml: I can repro something similar. With streaming=true and batching enabled, I see chunk boundaries that split inside object boundaries when prefix caching is enabled (model variant: open-large-v2). The recombiner expects chunks that are syntactically contiguous; if a generator emits an extra top-level key (weird) then the combiner can produce invalid JSON.

maya_ml: Quick debug notes:
```
- model: open-large-v2 (quantized)
- runtime commit: 8f4c2b7
- observed pattern: chunk A ends with `...,\"attributes\":null,`
  chunk B begins with `\"extra_field\":\"meta\"...` (no comma/spacing guarantees)
- combiner code assumes chunk boundaries preserve tokenization semantics -> not true for some kernel paths
```

maya_ml: Short-term workaround: set streaming=false or disable prefix_caching for the Dedicated pool. Also adding a client-side greedy-recombine that waits for a complete top-level object before parse helps. We'll ship a server-side fix but need a small window to validate.

oncall_bob: Deploy note — there's a hotfix branch that addresses recombiner ordering (PR #7621). I'll run canary in prod on a small fraction of traffic. Deploy-bot: scheduled rollout abc123 -> canary at 2026-03-06T02:15Z.

deploy-bot: deploy abc123 to prod (canary) — started by oncall_bob.

rita_billing: Noted the billing spike. If retries caused duplicate full requests we'll credit the affected request_ids after we confirm volume. Nora, can you share a short window (start/end timestamps) for the spike?

nora_cust: Spike window: 2026-03-05T15:40:00Z -> 2026-03-05T16:05:00Z. We saw ~120 errored parses and ~90 retries.

jordan_support: Thanks — billing will follow up. Maya, any estimate on fix timeline?

maya_ml: Canary looks good so far. If canary passes (~30m) we'll promote. Expect full rollout within 2–3 hours. The root cause is a recombiner regression introduced when we optimized kernel emission in commit 8f4c2b7; the fix enforces chunk-safe boundaries for structured output and normalizes whitespace between keys.

nora_cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll flip streaming=false as a temporary mitigation for now and let you know if errors persist.

jordan_support: Great. I'll keep this thread updated. For posterity, please also upload one of the raw client captures (pcap or raw stdout) to the support ticket so billing/eng can reconcile. :thumbsup: 

rita_billing: We'll audit the window and follow up with any credits.

oncall_bob: Canary promoted to prod at 2026-03-06T02:47Z, monitoring for parse errors.

nora_cust: Quick update — after switching streaming=false our parse exceptions stopped. We'll plan to re-enable after you confirm the rollout. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
